commands.feed_reserved: "{name}" is a /feed word; pick another name

feeds.display: Posts show as cards by default; /display density lines switches this window to IRC lines, /display avatars off and /display images off hide those, /display reset clears the overrides, and /set density, /set avatars and /set images change the default for every window.
feeds.editor: Your first run makes one called stream (home, mentions, DMs and notifications of every account); /feed edit {name}, /feed new or the ✎ button in a feed pane opens the editor.
feeds.labels: Every post has a short label like [a3]: /fav a3, /reply a3, /pop a3 act on it, as the account that fetched it.
feeds.merge: A feed merges any sources from any signed-in accounts into one stream, newest first, with a post several accounts see shown once.
feeds.sources: Sources are home, mentions, dms, notifications, local, federated and tag:{name}.

layout.buttons: Buttons: ◫▾ and ⊟▾ split with a view, ⧉ floats a pane, ⇲ docks a float, ✕ closes. Shift-drag a float over a pane to dock it against that edge.
layout.close: Closing a pane keeps its window; /close ends the window.
layout.desktop_close: Ctrl+B & (or the × after the active desktop in the status line, or a middle-click on any desktop) closes a desktop and keeps its windows open (/win); /desktop prune closes every empty one.
layout.desktop_keys: Alt+1..9 jump to a desktop, Alt+[ and Alt+] step to the previous and next one.
layout.navigation_keys: In navigation mode (Esc): w v / w s split, w h j k l focus, w c closes the pane, w o keeps only this one, w = equalizes, w f / w d float and dock.
layout.panes: The screen is a desktop of panes split side by side (row) or stacked (column); any pane can be torn off into a float, a window you drag around inside the viewport.
layout.phone: On a phone one pane shows at a time, with a ‹ 2/4 › switcher in its title bar.
layout.placement: Ctrl+click opens in a float, Shift+click in a side-by-side split, middle-click hidden; --in here|vsplit|split|float|hidden places any opened window.
layout.prefix_keys: Keys: Ctrl+B % / " split, Ctrl+B arrows focus, Ctrl+B x closes the pane, Ctrl+B z keeps only this one, Ctrl+B f / d float and dock.
layout.start_menu: Ctrl+B Space / w Space (or the [≡ wired] button at the left of the status line) opens the start menu, whose rows open a view as a float.

sync.accounts: A primary account holds the synced copy; ordered fallbacks take over when it has no settings store or its token fails (/sync primary {handle}, /sync fallback add|rm|up {handle}).
sync.budget: The server caps the whole store at 1 MiB, so a desk too big for the 384 KiB budget leaves out hidden windows, empty desktops and extra key overrides from the synced copy only, and says so.
sync.devices: Desktop browsers (Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS) and mobile ones (Android, iOS, iPadOS) each keep their own layout, and the newer copy wins.
sync.mastodon: Mastodon has no settings store: an account there keeps its desk in this browser alone.
sync.push: A push follows the last change by 3 seconds; /sync now pulls and pushes at once, /sync off and /sync on switch it.
sync.saved: Your desktops, floats, open windows, feeds and settings are saved in this browser and synced through your server, so the desk follows you.
